findings.problem: The picture contradicts the numbers. After the tokens flip, row 2 shows 7 green and 4 red (7 of 11 = 64%) beside a 75% bar, and row 3 shows 19 green and 12 red (61%) beside an 87% bar. The majority is never marked and the bars are headed only 'group is right', so a first-time learner reads 75% and 87% as the share of green tokens and sees a mismatch. Nothing says the bar is the chance, over many repeats, that the majority is right. The caption 'the majority wins' has no picture.
findings.fix: After each row flips, show the verdict: a count tag such as '7 v 4' with a green tick or 'majority right' (L5.tick) on the row. Re-head the bars 'majority is right, over many votes' (or 'chance the majority is right'), so a typical 7-of-11 vote can sit next to 75% without a clash. Keep the bar text at 28 px or more.
findings.evidence: s3@5.6 and s3@10.5: tokens 7 green / 4 red beside a 75% bar, 19 / 12 beside 87%, header only 'group is right'.

findings.problem: Caption 3, 'Thirty-one scouts are right 87% of the time.', starts at 6.2 s but the 87% bar only fills at 8.4 to 9.2 s, so the key number is on the caption about 2 s before it is on screen (house rule: a caption never runs ahead of its picture). The single scout token also stays grey for the whole scene while the 11 and 31 scouts flip, so '60% right' is shown only as a bar and the row looks unfinished. 'Scouts' is never introduced.
findings.fix: Start the caption with the bar fill (about 8.3 s) and use a shorter lead-in while the 31 tokens flip, for example 'Thirty-one scouts: better still.' from 6.2 s. Flip the single token once (green, matching its 60%) before the 11-scout row. Say 'scout ants' in the first row label or caption.
findings.evidence: s3@7.8: caption says 87%, bar 3 is still empty; s3@10.5: 1-scout token still grey.

findings.problem: The two bottom stickers do not teach their idea. 'emergent: no ant can alone' is a garbled definition (the verb is missing). 'finds the shortest route' is claimed with no route, destination or comparison anywhere in the scene, so the learner has no picture of what is being found. The scene is also long on a slowly bobbing ring while the payoff is two small stickers at 7.8 to 9.0 s.
findings.fix: Reword to 'emergent: more than any ant can do'. Either show a tiny nest, food and short and long road inside or beside the ring when the green sticker pops, or word it 'finds good routes together', and let scene 4 supply the routes.
findings.evidence: s2@9.8 (end of scene) and s2@8.2: caption 'find the shortest route', no route on stage.

findings.problem: The moving blue pulse reuses blue, which the video reserves for pheromone, but here it means 'information passing from neighbour to neighbour' and is unlabelled. A learner can read it as a scent trail.
findings.fix: Draw the pulse in ink or grey (or add a tiny 'passes the message' label) so blue stays pheromone only.
findings.evidence: s2@3.5 and s2@6.5: blue dot travelling the ring.

findings.problem: Share tags read '70% of ants' but the figure is the share of the last 10 ants (scene 5 says 'last 10 ants'), so 100% of ants on the upper bridge is a slight overclaim. The ink dots are never named as ants (scene 2 drew proper ants), and the blue landing ring at Food is unexplained.
findings.fix: Use 'last 10: 70%' style tags (still 28 px or more) and put a small ant dot in the legend row ('ant'), or make the first caption name them: 'Ants (dots) can cross...'.
findings.evidence: s4@7: '100% of ants' tag; s4@3.5: unexplained blue rings at Food.

findings.problem: Three small teaching gaps. (1) The title word 'paid' is never explained on screen; the picture shows pheromone arriving, so say that. (2) The tally card 'split 5%' is undefined (it means colonies that had not settled), and the 'step 60' counter stays beside '200 colonies' where it no longer means anything. (3) The long-road card is red but the long road in the picture is not coloured, so the colour link is by label only.
findings.fix: Retitle to 'The short bridge gets pheromone first' (or add a tag '+ pheromone laid' beside the first landing ring). Rename 'split' to 'undecided' (or add a one-line tag 'no clear winner'). Fade the step counter when the tally appears. Tint '5 steps' green and '10 steps' red when the tally pops.
findings.evidence: s5@10.4 and s5@12.5: 'split 5%' and 'step 60' next to '200 colonies'; title in every frame.

findings.problem: The feedback-loop panel is cramped against what follows: the third loop chip ends at about y 620 and the 'last 10 ants' tag starts 16 px below it, so the tag reads as part of the loop. The right half of the stage is empty from 1.0 to 4.5 s while the bridge plays on the left.
findings.fix: Leave about 30 px (or a short divider) between the loop and the 'last 10 ants' group, or move the stat up beside the step counter. Optionally pop the loop chips earlier.
findings.evidence: s5@5.5 (loop chips and tag nearly touching); s5@3.2 (empty right half).

findings.problem: Beat B is too quick for what it introduces. 'Sign-based' and 'Sematonic' appear together at 8.2 to 9.1 s and both mini pictures finish by about 10.2 s. The scene is at 50% fade by 10.9 s, so the finished two-card picture is on screen for under 1 s. A first-time learner gets about 2 s for two new terms plus a caption that covers both, while beat A spends 7 s on one ant walking along a trail.
findings.fix: Shorten beat A (ant 1 walk 0.8 to 2.8, ant 2 3.2 to 5.0, banner by 5.4) and give beat B about 2.5 s more. The video is 121.5 s, so there is room (limit about 130 s). Put the 'ants use this' tag in with the first card and hold the full picture for at least 1.5 s before the scene fade.
findings.evidence: s6@8.8 (cards just popped), s6@10.4 (pictures finishing), s6@10.9 (already fading).

findings.problem: After walking in, the second ant sits on the Food sticker and covers part of its label and the last blue dot. In the right-hand card the ant that drops the orange square is only about 7 px under the card's top edge.
findings.fix: Stop ant 2 a little short of Food (or fade it as it arrives). Lower the ant and the stacks in the right mini picture by about 10 px.
findings.evidence: s6@7.0 (ant on 'Food'); s6@9.5 (ant touching card top).

findings.problem: The tank numbers are never shown, so the idea 'it levels off at 20 and 10' is hard to follow. The dashed marks are unlabelled, the tank has no number, and the cards 'A: 4 ÷ 0.2 = 20' use 0.2 while the legend says '20% evaporates'. The chance bars 'A 67% / B 33%' do not show where 67 comes from (20 of 30), so the final bars look arbitrary.
findings.fix: Show the live level as a number on each tank (13.5, 17.9 ... 20.0). Label the dashed marks '20' and '10'. Write the cards as 'gain ÷ 20% = level' or add '(0.2 = 20%)'. Give the bar tag '20 of 30' and '10 of 30' (for example 'A: 20 of 30 = 67%').
findings.evidence: s7@7.0: dashed mark unlabelled, no tank number; s7@9.0: 'A 66% / B 25%' bars with no 20-of-30 link.

findings.problem: The scene never says what the map is for. Nothing on screen states the goal (a round trip through every town, as short as possible) or links the map to the bridge, so 'An ant starts on one town' arrives cold. The pheromone figures 24, 40 and 10 appear only inside the weight rows, while the roads carry distance pills, so the learner cannot see which road holds 24. The tour length (18) is not compared with anything.
findings.fix: Change the first caption or add a tag at 1.0 s such as 'same idea, four towns: visit every town, shortest round trip'. When the rows pop, show the pheromone number briefly in blue on the matching road pill (24 on A-B, 40 on A-C, 10 on A-D), or join row and road with the orange halo and a matching label.
findings.evidence: s8@1.4 (no goal stated), s8@3.5 (24, 40, 10 not tied to roads).

findings.problem: The dice does not match the chances. A six-sided die lands on 3 (then on 5) while the pills say 40%, 50% and 10%, so the picture says 'a die face picks the town' and the roll shows no link to those percentages. A learner may think face 3 means town C.
findings.fix: Replace the die roll with a 100-wide bar split 40 / 50 / 10 (orange segments) and a marker that lands in the C segment. Or keep the die and add 'random pick' without faces, landing the highlight on the matching row.
findings.evidence: s8@5.5 (die showing 2 pips beside 40 / 50 / 10), s8@6.5 (row C chosen, no face link).

findings.problem: The road pills show the same positions as scene 8's distances but now mean pheromone (24, 40, 10 ...). Only the colour changed (grey to blue) and nothing labels them until the caption at 2.6 s says 'pheromone'. The tour-memory tiles and the tour-length card also jump to new positions (tiles at x 85, y 645 instead of x 72, y 700), so the map does not feel like the same figure.
findings.fix: Add a blue tag 'pheromone on each road' as the pills pop (0.2 s). Keep the tour-memory row and the tour-length card exactly where scene 8 ended, or at least hold the tag 'tour memory'.
findings.evidence: s9@1.8 (unlabelled blue numbers, tiles moved); compare s8@13.5.

findings.problem: 'Q = 72' is never explained, and the '+4' that rises over each road fades while its text is already under 0.8 opacity. The tour roads are drawn in orange, which hides the blue trail width the learner is meant to see thicken.
findings.fix: Add 'Q = 72 (a fixed amount)' to the card. Keep '+4' at full opacity until it leaves. Draw the orange tour as a halo or outline under the blue trail.
findings.evidence: s9@6.3: pale '+4' labels; s9@5.4: 'Q = 72' with no definition.

findings.problem: The three rows 'trail per tour' with numbers (74, 94, 100 ... 21, 41, 21) are never explained: nothing says each number is the sum of the trail on that tour's four roads, or that these are the only three different tours of four towns. The turning point, the first short tour at ant 6, happens at 3.5 s in a 0.34 s step between ant 5 and ant 7, with the orange card swapping rows in one pop and no pause or flag, before the caption 'A shorter tour adds more to each road' (3.8 s). The +5.1 and +4 are shown without the sums (72 / 14, 72 / 18) from scene 9.
findings.fix: Add a small grey tag under the header: 'sum of trail on the tour's 4 roads' and '3 different tours'. Slow ants 4 to 7 (about 0.7 s each) or freeze for 0.8 s at ant 6 with a tag 'shorter tour found'. Show '72 ÷ 14 = 5.1' and '72 ÷ 18 = 4' in the card.
findings.evidence: s10@1.0 (unexplained 74 / 94 / 100), s10@3.2 to s10@3.9 (leader change within 0.3 s).

findings.problem: The last caption, 'Even though the first ants found only long tours.', is a dangling fragment (it only makes sense joined to the previous sentence) and it comes after the picture has already turned green.
findings.fix: Make it a full sentence about the final picture: 'The first ants found only long tours.' (or 'Early ants found long tours; the colony still wins.').
findings.evidence: s10@10.2: caption text with the 14 row turning green.

findings.problem: Several captions are too long for the house rule (about 9 words): 'Ants walk at the same speed, so the short trip ends first.' (12 words, scene 5), 'Visited towns go into its tour memory, so it never repeats one.' (12, scene 8), 'It carries on until every town is visited, then returns home.' (11, scene 8), 'Now one road is twice as long as the other.', 'A stronger trail has a higher chance of being picked.' and 'The ant has finished its tour. Now the trails update.' (10 each). Several run to two lines at 38 px.
findings.fix: Shorten to about 9 words or fewer: 'Same speed, so the short trip ends first.' / 'Visited towns go in tour memory: no repeats.' / 'It visits every town, then goes home.' / 'One road is twice as long.' / 'Stronger trails get picked more.' / 'Tour done. Now the trails update.'
findings.evidence: Caption text in the scene sources and stills s5@3.2, s8@7.5, s8@10.3.

findings.problem: The 12 px stage-margin rule is not met in most scenes: content is flush to the stage edge. Measured (stage at 936 x 640): left or right at 0 px in scene 3 (header tags, row labels), scene 5 (right cards, Nest at 9 px), scene 6 (ground band at 2 px, Nest and Food at 10 px), scene 8 (right panel and tour-memory row at 0 px), scene 9 (right cards at 7 to 12 px) and scene 10 (right panel at 0 px, 'strongest' tag at 9 px). The ant on town A or B pokes about 2 px above the stage top in scenes 8 to 10. Nothing is clipped because the stage sits inside the 72 px page margin, but the rule is broken throughout.
findings.fix: Inset these layouts by 12 px (for example start left columns at x 12 and end right columns at 924). If the storyboard's flush layout is accepted, note the exception; either way lower the map ant by about 14 px so it clears the stage top.
findings.evidence: DOM measurement over every scene (0.5 s steps) with a scratch script; stills s5@1.5, s8@2.4, s10@1.0.

findings.problem: The recap leaves out the double-bridge result (equal bridges give a random winner, the short bridge wins by positive feedback), which is the core of 7.2. In pictogram 2 the 'fade' (20 px down to 12 px) is barely visible on the finished frame and the last ant covers the right spot sticker, so 'fade' is not shown. Pictogram 3 has no number or pheromone cue beyond colour.
findings.fix: Optionally add a fourth idea or merge it into row 2 ('The short road gets pheromone first'). Make the trail visibly thin before the last ant arrives and stop the ant just before the sticker.
findings.evidence: s11@8.95 (pictogram 2: thick blue trail, ant on the sticker), s11@6.0.
